old.H2-P3: The inner pl/ork can start right where you live, though. [Peer counseling](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling) only requires two people and a place to talk privately. Reparenting, somatic work, working on jealousy, learning how to repair conflict, etc etc? None of that has to wait for a deed!
old.H2-P4: Even if a group practices together every week for two years, it may never own land. So what? It can still make a difference in how people get through divorce, illness, grief, parenting and plain old loneliness.
old.H3-P2: Start working on the inner pl/ork. With what? The free [reparenting guide](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/inner-child-self-love-tips-and-guided) and [Hearthwork manual](https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/p/hearthwork-an-integrated-peer-counseling), or another serious practice you already trust. And practice before you have an audience!
old.H3-P3: Find two or three people to form a practice group with (call it that, not a commune). Meet regularly, and learn to listen, switch roles, handle one disagreement and keep your commitments before you start talking about a shared future. One disagreement is enough!
old.H3-P4: Where can you find some of these people? Are there any unprogrammed Quaker meetings near you? How about restorative-practice groups? Maybe there's an open-hearted congregation, or a mature recovery group, or a meditation group you can check out. Or maybe you know someone who came back from a long retreat kinder, rather than more impressed with themselves.
